title: The bitcoin price level where leveraged bulls could get whacked

title: XRP slips below $1 even as a Korean regional bank adopts Ripple Payments

title: Monad, an Ethereum rival, offered early investors up to $60 million to cash out. Almost all said no
summary: The program came three months before investor unlocks begin, with MON trading below its public-sale price and most of the token supply still outside circulation.

title: Bitcoin climbs above $64,000 while most majors slip

title: Kraken parent Payward joins Anthropic’s Project Glasswing for AI security push
summary: Payward will use Anthropic’s cybersecurity model to hunt vulnerabilities and share open-source findings.
